status: test plan and fixtures; no measurements or recordings yet
negative_cases: spot off ball on each of three panels
controlled outward carry-and-pause motion using a thin support with operator outside images

annotations.format: JSON Lines, one record per stored frame; frame hash/camera/session/sequence/timestamps, ball centre+radius or null, spot or null, laser state and scenario/run boundaries
annotations.uncertain_labels: exclude from accuracy denominator with explicit reason; keep as missing/uncertain cases in run scoring, never turn into hits

reference_method.static: independent physical coordinates measured with <= 2 mm uncertainty; supports/operators outside images
reference_method.dynamic: manually labelled multi-view frames triangulated offline with static-validated calibration, independent of production detection/fusion; reference uncertainty <= 2 mm must be established; this is not an independent sensor truth claim
reference_method.synthetic: exact straight-line, circular and accelerating trajectories within 1000 mm/s and 4000 mm/s^2; exact sampling/clock/delivery schedule
reference_method.physical_end_to_end: time-weighted observed hits, 3 consecutive runs with 3 cameras and 3 with each pair; independent timing instrument and photodiode

recording.image_format: lossless PNG at the selected 640x480 capture rate; timestamps and calibration preserved
recording.mode: explicit reference profile; normal loop must not block
recording.on_overflow: count drops, stop/invalidate the affected reference take, preserve tracking; incomplete runs cannot qualify
recording.repository: manifest, annotations, replay observations and reviewed lossless reference pack; full raw takes retained in the local project reference archive, not silently committed as unbounded binaries
recording.manifest: SHA-256 file hashes, setup/profile/calibration IDs, room/light/daylight and exposure/gain/AWB settings, geometry/reference uncertainties, scope of each take; no people in stored images

qualification.failures: missing timestamps, bad metadata, frame backlogs, exposure >2 ms, row correction outside tolerance, insufficient contrast/calibration or unmet budgets fail qualification; no fabricated pass

deliverables: camera hardware/mode identification and reproducible settings
10-minute latency, rate, CPU/RAM and optical qualification report
